function cleanMasteryExport(){
  ensureArrays();const out=clone(data);migrateOverhaul(out);
  for(const cls of out.classes||[])for(const sk of cls.skills||[]){delete sk.powerPerLevel;if(sk.activation==='proc')delete sk.procChancePerLevel;delete sk.prerequisites;delete sk.prerequisiteSkill;delete sk.prerequisiteLevel;sk.requiredMasteryLevel=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Math.floor(Number(sk.requiredMasteryLevel)||0)));}
  for(const list of out.supportSkills||[])for(const sk of list||[]){delete sk.effectPerLevel;delete sk.prerequisites;delete sk.prerequisiteSkill;delete sk.prerequisiteLevel;sk.requiredMasteryLevel=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Math.floor(Number(sk.requiredMasteryLevel)||0)));}
  if(out.balanceSettings?.skills?.core){delete out.balanceSettings.skills.core.maxLevel;delete out.balanceSettings.skills.core.initialCap;delete out.balanceSettings.skills.core.capLevelsPerStep;delete out.balanceSettings.skills.core.effectPerExtraLevel;}if(out.balanceSettings?.skills?.proc)delete out.balanceSettings.skills.proc.perSkillLevel;if(out.balanceSettings?.skills?.support){delete out.balanceSettings.skills.support.maxLevel;delete out.balanceSettings.skills.support.effectPerExtraLevel;}
  out.notes=[...(out.notes||[]).filter(x=>!/powerPerLevel|procChancePerLevel|effectPerLevel|技能等級|每級|prerequisite|前置/i.test(String(x))),'第一次大修：技能只有未學／已學；技能點與技能等級舊欄位不再參與正式計算。','mastery / requiredMastery / requiredMasteryLevel / weaponTypes 為技能培養、學習與武器條件；requiredMasteryLevel 限制為 0～100。','iconType 控制技能頁小圖示；auto 會依效果、元素與精通自動判斷。','武器使用穩定 weaponType；weaponType 與 mastery 為獨立概念。'];return out;
}

  function finishChancePool(rows){
    let used=0;

      row.chance=i===rows.length-1?roundChance(100-used):roundChance(row.chance);
      used=roundChance(used+row.chance);
    });

function render(){
  ensureArrays();
  renderNav(true);
  const app=document.getElementById("app");
  const renderers={
    overview:renderOverview,classes:renderClasses,skills:renderSkills,
    equipment:renderEquipment,items:renderItems,balanceSettings:renderBalanceSettings,
    balance:renderBalance,raw:renderRaw
  };
  app.innerHTML="";
  renderers[currentSection]();
}
function sectionHead(title,desc,actions=""){
  return `<div class="section-head"><div><h1>${title}</h1><p>${desc}</p></div><div class="section-actions">${actions}</div></div>`;
}
function card(title,body,extra=""){
  return `<div class="card"><div class="card-h"><strong>${title}</strong>${extra}</div><div class="card-b">${body}</div></div>`;
}
function inputField(label,key,value,type="text",extra="",full=false,help="",readonly=false){
  const id="f_"+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
  return `<div class="field ${full?"full":""}"><label for="${id}">${fieldTitle(label,key,readonly)}</label><input id="${id}" data-key="${esc(key)}" type="${type}" value="${esc(value)}" ${extra} ${readonly?"readonly":""}>${helpText(help)}</div>`;
}
function selectField(label,key,value,opts,full=false,help="",labels=null,disabled=false){
  const id="f_"+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
  const pairs=opts.map(x=>typeof x==="object"?x:{value:x,label:labels?.[x]||x});
  return `<div class="field ${full?"full":""}"><label for="${id}">${fieldTitle(label,key,disabled)}</label><select id="${id}" data-key="${esc(key)}" ${disabled?"disabled":""}>${pairs.map(x=>`<option value="${esc(x.value)}" ${x.value===value?"selected":""}>${esc(x.label)}</option>`).join("")}</select>${helpText(help)}</div>`;
}
function boolField(label,key,value,help=""){
  const id="f_"+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
  return `<div class="field"><label for="${id}">${fieldTitle(label,key,false)}</label><select id="${id}" data-key="${esc(key)}"><option value="false" ${!value?"selected":""}>否</option><option value="true" ${value?"selected":""}>是</option></select>${helpText(help)}</div>`;
}
function textareaField(label,key,value,help=""){
  const id="f_"+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
  return `<div class="field full"><label for="${id}">${fieldTitle(label,key,false)}</label><textarea id="${id}" data-key="${esc(key)}">${esc(value)}</textarea>${helpText(help)}</div>`;
}
function bindObjectFields(container,obj){
  container.querySelectorAll("[data-key]").forEach(el=>{
    el.onchange=()=>{
      const k=el.dataset.key;
      if(el.dataset.json==="1"){
        try{obj[k]=JSON.parse(el.value); el.style.borderColor=""; markDirty();}catch{el.style.borderColor="var(--danger)";}
        return;
      }
      if(el.type==="number") obj[k]=el.value===""?0:Number(el.value);
      else if(el.dataset.bool==="1" || (el.tagName==="SELECT" && (el.value==="true"||el.value==="false"))) obj[k]=el.value==="true";
      else obj[k]=el.value;
      markDirty();
    };
  });
}
function confirmDelete(msg){ return window.confirm(msg); }

  document.getElementById
---
)+'>'+SKILL_USAGE_SCOPE_LABELS[v]+'</option>').join("")+'</select>';
  if(companionSkillOwner())return '<div class="toolbar skill-workspace-toolbar"><div class="tabs">'+tabs.map(([id,label])=>'<button type="button" class="'+(activeTab===id?'primary':'')+'" data-skill-tab="'+id+'">'+label+'</button>').join('')+'</div></div>';
  return '<div class="toolbar skill-workspace-toolbar"><label style="margin:0">角色</label><select id="skillClassSel">'+
    data.classes.map((x,i)=>'<option value="'+i+'" '+(i===selected.skillClass?'selected':'')+'>'+esc(x.name)+'</option>').join('')+
    '</select>'+scope+'<div class="tabs">'+tabs.map(([id,label])=>'<button type="button" class="'+(activeTab===id?'primary':'')+'" data-skill-tab="'+id+'">'+label+'</button>').join('')+'</div></div>';
}
function bindSkillWorkspaceToolbar(){
  const sel=document.getElementById("skillClassSel");
  if(sel)sel.onchange=()=>{selected.skillClass=Number(sel.value);selected.supportClass=selected.skillClass;selected.skill=0;selected.support=0;render();};
  const scope=document.getElementById("skillScopeFilter");
  if(scope)scope.onchange=()=>{selected.skillScopeFilter=scope.value;selected.skill=-1;render();};
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-skill-tab]").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{selected.skillTab=b.dataset.skillTab;selected.supportClass=selected.skillClass;selected.skill=0;selected.support=0;render();});
}

function renderSkills(){
  ensureArrays();
  selected.skillTab=["active","proc","support"].includes(selected.skillTab)?selected.skillTab:"active";
  selected.skillScopeFilter=["all",...SKILL_USAGE_SCOPES].includes(selected.skillScopeFilter)?selected.skillScopeFilter:"all";
  selected.skillClass=Math.min(selected.skillClass,Math.max(0,data.classes.length-1));
  selected.supportClass=selected.skillClass;

  if(selected.skillTab==="support"){
    renderSupport();
    const app=document.getElementById("app"),head=app.querySelector(".section-head"),oldToolbar=app.querySelector(".toolbar");
    if(head){
      const title=head.querySelector("h1"),desc=head.querySelector("p");
      if(title)title.textContent="主角技能";
      if(desc)desc.textContent="人物用途的技能僅供主角使用；怪物用途依原用途分類配置。夥伴技能在各自的專屬技能頁設計。";
    }
    if(oldToolbar)oldToolbar.remove();
    if(head)head.insertAdjacentHTML("afterend",skillWorkspaceToolbar("support"));
    bindSkillWorkspaceToolbar();
    return;
  }

  const skillMode=selected.skillTab,c=data.classes[selected.skillClass];
  const skills=c&&Array.isArray(c.skills)?c.skills:(c?(c.skills=[]):[]);
  const visible=skills.map((sk,i)=>({sk,i})).filter(x=>x.sk.activation===skillMode&&companionSkillVisible(x.sk)&&(selected.skillScopeFilter==="all"||normalizeSkillUsageScope(x.sk)===selected.skillScopeFilter));
  if(!visible.some(x=>x.i===selected.skill))selected.skill=visible.length?visible[0].i:-1;
  const sk=selected.skill>=0?skills[selected.skill]:null;
  if(sk)ensureProcSkillFields(sk);
  const procOnly=sk&&PROC_ONLY_EFFECTS.has(sk.effect),effectOptions=skillMode==="proc"?EFFECTS:EFFECTS.filter(x=>!PROC_ONLY_EFFECTS.has(x));
  const effectHelp=skillMode==="proc"?"proc 可使用一般傷害／治療／護盾／吸血，或三種觸發專屬效果。觸發專屬效果不能配置給 active 技能。":"active 技能可使用傷害、治療、護盾、吸血、淨化、驅散、復活及既有控制效果。";
  const powerHelp=sk?.effect==="nextActiveDamage"?"0.25 = 基礎 +25% 下次主動技能傷害；技能等級、寶石與指定技能效果詞條仍會放大此比例。":sk?.effect==="advanceNextRound"?"此效果固定前移 1 格，不使用 power；保留欄位只為 JSON 結構相容。":sk?.effect==="shieldLowest"?"以施放者攻擊力為基準；0.8 = 產生攻擊力 80% 的純護盾，給生命比例最低的存活隊友。":'最終技能量先以「角色攻擊力 × 此倍率」為基礎，再乘技能等級、寶石、指定技能效果詞條與輔助技能 power。1 = 100% 攻擊力。';

  document.getElementById("app").innerHTML =
    sectionHead("主角技能","人物用途的技能僅供主角使用；怪物用途依原用途分類配置。夥伴技能在各自的專屬技能頁設計。",
      '<button id="addSkill" '+(c?"":"disabled")+'>新增'+(skillMode==="proc"?"觸發":"主動")+'技能</button>'+(sk?'<button id="dupSkill">複製技能</button><button id="delSkill" class="danger">刪除技能</button>':""))+
    '<div class="notice">主動技能與普攻觸發技能仍共用 classes[].skills 陣列索引；「用途分類」決定人物或哪類怪物可使用同一技能定義。既有存檔以索引保存技能等級與寶石，正式資料請避免任意重排。</div>'+
    skillWorkspaceToolbar(skillMode)+
    '<div class="grid2"><div class="card"><div class="list">'+
      (visible.map(({sk:x,i})=>'<div class="listitem '+(i===selected.skill?"active":"")+'" data-skill="'+i+'"><div class="title">'+esc(x.name||"(未命名技能)")+'</div><div class="sub">'+esc(SKILL_USAGE_SCOPE_LABELS[normalizeSkillUsageScope(x)]||"人物")+' · '+esc(ACTIVATION_LABELS[x.activation]||x.activation)+' · '+esc(EFFECT_LABELS[x.effect]||x.effect)+' · LV.'+esc(x.requiredLevel)+'</div></div>').join("")||'<div class="empty">此分頁目前沒有技能，可直接新增。</div>')+
    '</div></div>'+
    (sk?card("技能資料",'<div class="fields">'+
      inputField("技能 ID（共用識別）","id",sk

  const controlRenderSkillsBase=renderSkills;
  renderSkills=function(){
    controlRenderSkillsBase();
    if(selected.skillTab==='support')return;
    const cls=data.classes?.[selected.skillClass],sk=selected.skill>=0?cls?.skills?.[selected.skill]:null;
    if(!sk||!CONTROL_EFFECTS.includes(sk.effect))return;
    normalize(sk);
    const app=document.getElementById('app'),grid=app.querySelector('.grid2');if(!grid)return;
    const box=document.createElement('div');box.className='card';box.id='control-mechanic-card';
    box.innerHTML='<h2>控制／召喚機制</h2><div class="fields">'+controlFields(sk)+'</div>';
    grid.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',box);bindObjectFields(box,sk);
  };

  const controlValidateBase=validateData;
  validateData=function(){
    const issues=controlValidateBase();ensureRows(data);
    data.classes.forEach((c,job)=>(c.skills||[]).forEach((sk,i)=>{
      if(!CONTROL_EFFECTS.includes(sk.effect))return;
      normalize(sk);
      const nums=['duration','bossDuration','slowPct','basicAttackBonus','skipChance','bossSkipChance','damageReduction','trapHp'];
      for(const k of nums)if(!Number.isFinite(Number(sk[k])))issues.push('角色 '+job+' 技能 '+i+' 的控制參數 '+k+' 無效。');
      for(const k of ['slowPct','basicAttackBonus','skipChance','bossSkipChance','damageReduction'])if(Number(sk[k])<0||Number(sk[k])>1)issues.push('角色 '+job+' 技能 '+i+' 的 '+k+' 必須介於 0～1。');
      if(Number(sk.duration)<0||Number(sk.bossDuration)<0||Number(sk.trapHp)<1)issues.push('角色 '+job+' 技能 '+i+' 的控制回合／陷阱生命無效。');
    }));
    return [...new Set(issues)];
  };

  if(!document.getElementById('control-editor-style')){
    const st=document.createElement('style');st.id='control-editor-style';st.textContent='#control-mechanic-card{margin-top:14px}#control-mechanic-card .notice{grid-column:1/-1;margin:0}';document.head.appendChild(st);
  }

  const controlRenderSkillsBase=renderSkills;
  renderSkills=function(){
    controlRenderSkillsBase();
    if(selected.skillTab==='support')return;
    const cls=data.classes?.[selected.skillClass],sk=selected.skill>=0?cls?.skills?.[selected.skill]:null;
    if(!sk||!CONTROL_EFFECTS.includes(sk.effect))return;
    normalize(sk);
    const app=document.getElementById('app'),grid=app.querySelector('.grid2');if(!grid)return;
    const box=document.createElement('div');box.className='card';box.id='control-mechanic-card';

    grid.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',box);bindObjectFields(box,sk);
  };

  const controlValidateBase=validateData;
  validateData=function(){
    const issues=controlValidateBase();ensureRows(data);
    data.classes.forEach((c,job)=>(c.skills||[]).forEach((sk,i)=>{
      if(!CONTROL_EFFECTS.includes(sk.effect))return;
      normalize(sk);
      const nums=['duration','bossDuration','slowPct','basicAttackBonus','skipChance','bossSkipChance','damageReduction','trapHp'];
      for(const k of nums)if(!Number.isFinite(Number(sk[k])))issues.push('角色 '+job+' 技能 '+i+' 的控制參數 '+k+' 無效。');
      for(const k of ['slowPct','basicAttackBonus','skipChance','bossSkipChance','damageReduction'])if(Number(sk[k])<0||Number(sk[k])>1)issues.push('角色 '+job+' 技能 '+i+' 的 '+k+' 必須介於 0～1。');
      if(Number(sk.duration)<0||Number(sk.bossDuration)<0||Number(sk.trapHp)<1)issues.push('角色 '+job+' 技能 '+i+' 的控制回合／陷阱生命無效。');
    }));
    return [...new Set(issues)];
  };

  if(!document.getElementById('control-editor-style')){
    const st=document.createElement('style');st.id='control-editor-style';st.textContent='#control-mechanic-card{margin-top:14px}#control-mechanic-card .notice{grid-column:1/-1;margin:0}';document.head.appendChild(st);
  }
  globalThis.__EMBERWILD_CONTROL_EDITOR={effects:[...CONTROL_EFFECTS],ensure:()=>{ensureRows(data);render();}};
  if(added)markDirty('已加入控制狀態、陷阱與新職業技能資料');
  render();
})();

function bindSkillIconCard(sk){
  const el=document.getElementById('skillIconType');if(el)el.onchange=()=>{sk.iconType=validSkillIconType(el.value)?el.value:'auto';document.getElementById('skillIconPreview').innerHTML=ICONS.svgFor(previewSkillIcon(sk),Array.isArray(data.skillIcons)?data.skillIcons:[]);markDirty();};
  document.getElementById('openSkillIconMaker')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{window.__SKILL_ICON_RETURN=true;currentSection='iconMaker';render();});
}
function bindMasteryCard(sk){
  const m=document.getElementById('skillMastery'),r=document.getElementById('skillRequiredMastery'),lv=document.getElementById('skillRequiredMasteryLevel');
  if(m)m.onchange=()=>{sk.mastery=m.value||null;markDirty();};if(r)r.onchange=()=>{sk.requiredMastery=r.value||null;if(!sk.requiredMastery){sk.requiredMasteryLevel=0;if(lv)lv.value='0';}markDirty();};if(lv)lv.onchange=()=>{sk.requiredMasteryLevel=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Math.floor(Number(lv.value)||0)));lv.value=String(sk.requiredMasteryLevel);markDirty();};
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-skill-weapon]').forEach(el=>el.onchange=()=>{const set=new Set(sk.weaponTypes||[]);if(el.checked)set.add(el.dataset.skillWeapon);else set.delete(el.dataset.skillWeapon);sk.weaponTypes=[...set];markDirty();});
}

function deepFillDefaults(def,src){
  if(Array.isArray(def))return def.map((v,i)=>deepFillDefaults(v,Array.isArray(src)?src[i]:undefined));
  if(def&&typeof def==="object"){const out=src&&typeof src==="object"&&!Array.isArray(src)?structuredClone(src):{};for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(def))out[k]=deepFillDefaults(v,src&&typeof src==="object"?src[k]:undefined);return out;}
  return src===undefined?def:src;
}
function flattenSettingLeaves(v,path="",out=[]){
  if(Array.isArray(v)){v.forEach((x,i)=>flattenSettingLeaves(x,path?path+"."+i:String(i),out));return out;}
  if(v&&typeof v==="object"){for(const [k,x] of Object.entries(v))flattenSettingLeaves(x,path?path+"."+k:k,out);return out;}
  out.push([path,v]);return out;
}

  out.push([path,v]);return out;
}

const SUPPORT_PLAN=[[{},{},{}],[{mastery:'wind'},{mastery:'ice'},{mastery:'fire'}],[{},{},{}],[{mastery:'light'},{mastery:'light'},{mastery:'light'}]];
const MASTERY_DEFAULTS={xpBase:8,xpLinear:5,xpQuadratic:1,skillUseXp:2,basicAttackXp:1,maxLevel:30,advanceRequiredLevel:4,characterXpMultiplier:1.35};

function ensureSettings(obj){
  obj.balanceSettings??={};obj.balanceSettings.progression??={};obj.balanceSettings.progression.starting??={};obj.balanceSettings.progression.levelRewards??={};
  obj.balanceSettings.progression.starting.skillPoints=0;obj.balanceSettings.progression.levelRewards.skillPoints=0;
  if(obj.balanceSettings.quests?.tutorial)obj.balanceSettings.quests.tutorial.skillLevelRequirement=1;
  obj.balanceSettings.skills??={};obj.balanceSettings.skills.mastery??={};
  const m=obj.balanceSettings.skills.mastery;
  for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(MASTERY_DEFAULTS))if(!Number.isFinite(Number(m[k])))m[k]=v;
  m.xpBase=Math.max(1,Number(m.xpBase));m.xpLinear=Math.max(0,Number(m.xpLinear));m.xpQuadratic=Math.max(0,Number(m.xpQuadratic));m.skillUseXp=Math.max(0,Number(m.skillUseXp));m.basicAttackXp=Math.max(0,Number(m.basicAttackXp));m.maxLevel=Math.max(1,Math.floor(Number(m.maxLevel)));m.advanceRequiredLevel=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(m.advanceRequiredLevel)));m.characterXpMultiplier=Math.max(1,Number(m.characterXpMultiplier));
}
function migrateOverhaul(obj){
  if(!obj||typeof obj!=='object')return obj;ensureSettings(obj);obj.balanceSettings.meta??={};const already=Number(obj.balanceSettings.meta.masteryOverhaulVersion)>=1;
  obj.masteryTypes=MASTERY_BY_JOB.map((types,job)=>({job,types:[...types]}));
  for(let job=0;job<(obj.classes||[]).length;job++){
    const skills=obj.classes[job]?.skills||[],defaultPattern=skills.length>=6&&skills.slice(0,6).every((sk,i)=>Number(sk.requiredLevel)===OLD_LEVELS[i]);
    for(let i=0;i<skills.length;i++){const sk=skills[i],plan=CORE_PLAN[job]?.[i]||{},valid=new Set(MASTERY_BY_JOB[job]||[]);
      if(!already&&defaultPattern&&i<NEW_LEVELS.length)sk.requiredLevel=NEW_LEVELS[i];
      if(!already&&job===3&&[2,3].includes(i)&&sk.element==='light')sk.element='shadow';
      if(sk.mastery===undefined)sk.mastery=plan.mastery??null;if(sk.requiredMastery===undefined)sk.requiredMastery=plan.requiredMastery??null;if(!Number.isInteger(sk.requiredMasteryLevel))sk.requiredMasteryLevel=plan.requiredMasteryLevel??0;
      if(!Array.isArray(sk.weaponTypes))sk.weaponTypes=clone(plan.weaponTypes||[]);sk.weaponTypes=sk.weaponTypes.filter(x=>WEAPON_TYPE_SET.has(x));if(!validSkillIconType(sk.iconType,obj))sk.iconType='auto';
      delete sk.prerequisites;delete sk.prerequisiteSkill;delete sk.prerequisiteLevel;sk.powerPerLevel=0;
      if(sk.activation==='proc'){ensureProcSkillFields(sk);sk.procChancePerLevel=0;}
      if(sk.mastery!==null&&!valid.has(sk.mastery))sk.mastery=plan.mastery??null;if(sk.requiredMastery!==null&&!valid.has(sk.requiredMastery))sk.requiredMastery=plan.requiredMastery??null;
    }
    const supports=obj.supportSkills?.[job]||[],supportPattern=supports.length===3&&supports.every((sk,i)=>Number(sk.level)===OLD_SUPPORT[i]);
    for(let i=0;i<supports.length;i++){const sk=supports[i],plan=SUPPORT_PLAN[job]?.[i]||{},valid=new Set(MASTERY_BY_JOB[job]||[]);
      if(!already&&supportPattern)sk.level=NEW_SUPPORT[i];if(sk.mastery===undefined)sk.mastery=plan.mastery??null;if(sk.requiredMastery===undefined)sk.requiredMastery=null;if(!Number.isInteger(sk.requiredMasteryLevel))sk.requiredMasteryLevel=0;
      if(!Array.isArray(sk.weaponTypes))sk.weaponTypes=[];sk.weaponTypes=sk.weaponTypes.filter(x=>WEAPON_TYPE_SET.has(x));if(!validSkillIconType(sk.iconType,obj))sk.iconType='auto';delete sk.prerequisites;delete sk.prerequisiteSkill;de

function migrateOverhaul(obj){
  if(!obj||typeof obj!=='object')return obj;ensureSettings(obj);obj.balanceSettings.meta??={};const already=Number(obj.balanceSettings.meta.masteryOverhaulVersion)>=1;
  obj.masteryTypes=MASTERY_BY_JOB.map((types,job)=>({job,types:[...types]}));
  for(let job=0;job<(obj.classes||[]).length;job++){
    const skills=obj.classes[job]?.skills||[],defaultPattern=skills.length>=6&&skills.slice(0,6).every((sk,i)=>Number(sk.requiredLevel)===OLD_LEVELS[i]);
    for(let i=0;i<skills.length;i++){const sk=skills[i],plan=CORE_PLAN[job]?.[i]||{},valid=new Set(MASTERY_BY_JOB[job]||[]);
      if(!already&&defaultPattern&&i<NEW_LEVELS.length)sk.requiredLevel=NEW_LEVELS[i];
      if(!already&&job===3&&[2,3].includes(i)&&sk.element==='light')sk.element='shadow';
      if(sk.mastery===undefined)sk.mastery=plan.mastery??null;if(sk.requiredMastery===undefined)sk.requiredMastery=plan.requiredMastery??null;if(!Number.isInteger(sk.requiredMasteryLevel))sk.requiredMasteryLevel=plan.requiredMasteryLevel??0;
      if(!Array.isArray(sk.weaponTypes))sk.weaponTypes=clone(plan.weaponTypes||[]);sk.weaponTypes=sk.weaponTypes.filter(x=>WEAPON_TYPE_SET.has(x));if(!validSkillIconType(sk.iconType,obj))sk.iconType='auto';
      delete sk.prerequisites;delete sk.prerequisiteSkill;delete sk.prerequisiteLevel;sk.powerPerLevel=0;
      if(sk.activation==='proc'){ensureProcSkillFields(sk);sk.procChancePerLevel=0;}
      if(sk.mastery!==null&&!valid.has(sk.mastery))sk.mastery=plan.mastery??null;if(sk.requiredMastery!==null&&!valid.has(sk.requiredMastery))sk.requiredMastery=plan.requiredMastery??null;
    }
    const supports=obj.supportSkills?.[job]||[],supportPattern=supports.length===3&&supports.every((sk,i)=>Number(sk.level)===OLD_SUPPORT[i]);
    for(let i=0;i<supports.length;i++){const sk=supports[i],plan=SUPPORT_PLAN[job]?.[i]||{},valid=new Set(MASTERY_BY_JOB[job]||[]);
      if(!already&&supportPattern)sk.level=NEW_SUPPORT[i];if(sk.mastery===undefined)sk.mastery=plan.mastery??null;if(sk.requiredMastery===undefined)sk.requiredMastery=null;if(!Number.isInteger(sk.requiredMasteryLevel))sk.requiredMasteryLevel=0;
      if(!Array.isArray(sk.weaponTypes))sk.weaponTypes=[];sk.weaponTypes=sk.weaponTypes.filter(x=>WEAPON_TYPE_SET.has(x));if(!validSkillIconType(sk.iconType,obj))sk.iconType='auto';delete sk.prerequisites;delete sk.prerequisiteSkill;delete sk.prerequisiteLevel;sk.effectPerLevel=0;
      if(sk.

  obj.balanceSettings.meta.masteryOverhaulVersion=1;return obj;
}

function masteryOptions(job,value){return [['','無'],...(MASTERY_BY_JOB[job]||[]).map(k=>[k,(MASTERY_LABELS[k]||k)+'精通'])].map(([v,label])=>`<option value="${esc(v)}" ${String(value??'')===v?'selected':''}>${esc(label)}</option>`).join('');}
function masteryEditorCard(job,sk){
  const allowed=JOB_WEAPONS[job]||WEAPON_TYPES,selectedWeapons=new Set(sk.weaponTypes||[]);
  return card('精通與武器條件',`<div class="mastery-editor-grid"><div class="field"><label>使用時培養精通</label><select id="skillMastery">${masteryOptions(job,sk.mastery)}</select><div class="field-help">成功使用技能後增加此精通 XP；無代表不提供精通。</div></div><div class="field"><label>學習需求精通</label><select id="skillRequiredMastery">${masteryOptions(job,sk.requiredMastery)}</select><div class="field-help">與角色等級共同判斷；選「無」時精通等級要求固定為 0。</div></div><div class="field"><label>需求精通等級</label><input id="skillRequiredMasteryLevel" type="number" min="0" max="100" step="1" value="${esc(sk.requiredMasteryLevel??0)}"><div class="field-help">可設定 0～100 的整數。</div></div><div class="field"><label>允許使用武器</label><div class="mastery-editor-weapons">${allowed.map(k=>`<label><input type="checkbox" data-skill-weapon="${k}" ${selectedWeapons.has(k)?'checked':''}>${esc(WEAPON_TYPE_LABELS[k])}</label>`).join('')}</div><div class="field-help">空白代表不限制武器；weaponType 與 mastery 是不同概念。</div></div></div>`);
}

  return card('精通與武器條件',`<div class="mastery-editor-grid"><div class="field"><label>使用時培養精通</label><select id="skillMastery">${masteryOptions(job,sk.mastery)}</select><div class="field-help">成功使用技能後增加此精通 XP；無代表不提供精通。</div></div><div class="field"><label>學習需求精通</label><select id="skillRequiredMastery">${masteryOptions(job,sk.requiredMastery)}</select><div class="field-help">與角色等級共同判斷；選「無」時精通等級要求固定為 0。</div></div><div class="field"><label>需求精通等級</label><input id="skillRequiredMasteryLevel" type="number" min="0" max="100" step="1" value="${esc(sk.requiredMasteryLevel??0)}"><div class="field-help">可設定 0～100 的整數。</div></div><div class="field"><label>允許使用武器</label><div class="mastery-editor-weapons">${allowed.map(k=>`<label><input type="checkbox" data-skill-weapon="${k}" ${selectedWeapons.has(k)?'checked':''}>${esc(WEAPON_TYPE_LABELS[k])}</label>`).join('')}</div><div class="field-help">空白代表不限制武器；weaponType 與 mastery 是不同概念。</div></div></div>`);
}
function skillIconEditorCard(sk){
  const definitions=Array.isArray(data.skillIcons)?data.skillIcons:[];
  const builtIn=SKILL_ICON_TYPES.map(k=>`<option value="${k}" ${sk.iconType===k?'selected':''}>${esc(SKILL_ICON_LABELS[k]||k)}</option>`).join('');
  const custom=definitions.map(icon=>`<option value="custom:${esc(icon.id)}" ${sk.iconType==='custom:'+icon.id?'selected':''}>自製 · ${esc(icon.name)}</option>`).join('');
  const selected=previewSkillIcon(sk);
  return card('技能圖示',`<div class="skill-icon-picker"><div id="skillIconPreview" class="skill-icon-picker-preview">${ICONS.svgFor(selected,definitions)}</div><div class="field"><label for="skillIconType">選擇圖示</label><select id="skillIconType">${builtIn}${custom}</select><div class="field-help">可選通用符號，也可在圖示製作器中組合。自動判斷會依職業、效果與元素選圖。</div><button type="button" id="openSkillIconMaker">開啟圖示製作器</button></div></div>`);
}

function sanitizeLegacyMonsterSkillData(root){
  const monsters=root?.balanceSettings?.monsters??root?.monsters;if(!monsters)return root;
  const hadLegacyPool=Array.isArray(monsters.skills)||monsters.skillSystem!==undefined;
  delete monsters.skills;delete monsters.skillSystem;
  if(hadLegacyPool)for(const row of monsters.catalog||[])if(row&&typeof row==='object')delete row.skillAssignments;
  return root;
}

function migrateActiveCooldownFloorEditor(root){
  if(!root||typeof root!=='object')return root;
  root.balance??={};root.balance.combat??={};root.balanceSettings??={};root.balanceSettings.meta??={};
  if(Number(root.balanceSettings.meta.activeCooldownFloorVersion||0)<1){
    if(Number(root.balance.combat.minimumActiveCooldown)===2)root.balance.combat.minimumActiveCooldown=1;
    root.balanceSettings.meta.activeCooldownFloorVersion=1;
  }
  return root;
}

const MONSTER_KIND_LABELS={normal:'普通怪',boss:'地圖首領',final:'最終首領'};
const DROP_KIND_LABELS={normal:'普通',elite:'菁英',boss:'首領',final:'最終首領'};
const DROP_TYPE_LABELS={sourceMaterial:'怪物自身素材',material:'指定材料',ore:'鍛鐵',dust:'粉塵',gem:'技能寶石',potion:'治療藥水',gear:'一般裝備',gearLegendary:'傳說詞條裝備',bossGear:'BOSS專屬裝備',item:'商店道具'};
function ensureMonsterDropArrays(){data.balance??={};data.balance.affixes??={};data.balance.affixes.extendedValues??={};data.balance.affixes.extendedValues.dropRateBonus??={normal:0,fine:5,rare:10,legendary:20};data.balanceSettings??={};data.balanceSettings.monsters??={};data.balanceSettings.monsters.catalog??=structuredClone(BALANCE_SETTINGS_DEFAULTS.monsters.catalog||[]);data.balanceSettings.drops??={entries:structuredClone(BALANCE_SETTINGS_DEFAULTS.drops?.entries||[])};data.balanceSettings.drops.entries??=[];}
function monsterOptions(selected){return data.balanceSettings.monsters.catalog.map(m=>`<option value="${esc(m.id)}" ${selected?.includes(m.id)?'selected':''}>${esc(MAP_NAMES[m.mapIndex]||('地圖 '+m.mapIndex))}｜${esc(m.name)}｜${esc(m.id)}</option>`).join('');}
function monsterCatalogEditorHTML(){const list=data.balanceSettings.monsters.catalog;return `<section class="md-card"><div class="row"><div><h3>怪物設計</h3><p class="mini-note">怪物 ID 是掉落表的穩定連結。可改名稱，但已被掉落規則引用時不要直接改 ID。新增怪物後會立即出現在掉落來源選單。</p></div><button id="addMonster">新增怪物</button></div>${list.map((m,i)=>`<article class="md-card" data-monster-row="${i}"><div class="row"><h4>${esc(m.name||'未命名怪物')}</h4><div><button class="small monster-copy">複製</button><button class="small danger monster-delete">刪除</button></div></div><div class="md-fields"><label>怪物 ID<input class="monster-field" data-key="id" value="${esc(m.id)}"></label><label>名稱<input class="monster-field" data-key="name" value="${esc(m.name)}"></label><label>地圖<select class="monster-field" data-key="mapIndex">${MAP_NAMES.map((n,mi)=>`<option value="${mi}" ${mi===m.mapIndex?'selected':''}>${mi}｜${esc(n)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label><label>類型<select class="monster-field" data-key="kind">${Object.entries(MONSTER_KIND_LABELS).map(([v,l])=>`<option value="${v}" ${m.kind===v?'selected':''}>${l}</option>`).join('')}</select></label><label>主要素材<input class="monster-field" data-key="material" value="${esc(m.material)}"></label><label>元素<select class="monster-field" data-key="element">${ELEMENTS.map(v=>`<option value="${v}" ${m.element===v?'selected':''}>${esc(ELEMENT_LABELS[v]||v)}</option>`).join('')}</select></label><label>種族<select class="monster-field" data-key="race">${Object.entries({beast:'野獸',plant:'植物',undead:'不死',construct:'構裝',demon:'惡魔',spirit:'精靈'}).map(([v,l])=>`<option value="${v}" ${m.race===v?'selected':''}>${l}</option>`).join('')}</select></label><label>最大掉落物數<input class="monster-field" data-key="maxDrops" type="number" min="0" max="100" step="1" value="${esc(m.maxDrops)}"></label></div></article>`).join('')}</section>`;}

<script>
/* Update 16: editor validation parity with game monster/drop schema. */
const update16EditorValidateBase=validateData;
validateData=function(){
  const issues=update16EditorValidateBase();ensureArrays();
  const cat=data.balanceSettings?.monsters?.catalog||[],drops=data.balanceSettings?.drops?.entries||[];
  const ids=new Set(),monsterById=new Map(),races=new Set(['beast','plant','undead','construct','demon','spirit']),monsterKinds=new Set(Object.keys(MONSTER_KIND_LABELS)),dropKinds=new Set(Object.keys(DROP_KIND_LABELS)),dropTypes=new Set(Object.keys(DROP_TYPE_LABELS));
  for(const [i,m] of cat.entries()){
    if(typeof m?.id!=='string'||!/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,100}$/.test(m.id)||ids.has(m.id))issues.push(`怪物第 ${i+1} 筆 ID 必須為 1~100 字元英數、底線或連字號，且不可重複。`);
    if(m?.id)ids.add(m.id);if(m?.id)monsterById.set(m.id,m);
    if(typeof m?.name!=='string'||!m.name.trim())issues.push(`怪物 ${m?.id||i+1} 名稱不可空白。`);
    if(!Number.isInteger(m?.mapIndex)||m.mapIndex<0||m.mapIndex>=MAP_NAMES.length)issues.push(`怪物 ${m?.id||i+1} 地圖索引無效。`);
    if(!monsterKinds.has(m?.kind))issues.push(`怪物 ${m?.id||i+1} 類型無效。`);
    if(typeof m?.material!=='string'||!m.material.trim())issues.push(`怪物 ${m?.id||i+1} 主要素材不可空白。`);
    if(!ELEMENTS.includes(m?.element))issues.push(`怪物 ${m?.id||i+1} 元素無效。`);
    if(!races.has(m?.race))issues.push(`怪物 ${m?.id||i+1} 種族無效。`);
    if(Number.isInteger(m?.mapIndex)&&m.mapIndex>=0&&m.mapIndex<MAP_NAMES.length&&monsterKinds.has(m?.kind)){const expected=m.mapIndex===6?'final':'boss';if(m.kind!=='normal'&&m.kind!==expected)issues.push(`怪物 ${m.id||i+1} 類型與地圖不相容：終焉王座使用最終首領，其餘地圖使用地圖首領。`);}
  }
  const dids=new Set();
  for(const [i,d] of drops.entries()){
    if(typeof d?.id!=='string'||!/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,120}$/.test(d.id)||dids.has(d.id))issues.push(`掉落規則第 ${i+1} 筆 ID 必須為 1~120 字元英數、底線或連字號，且不可重複。`);
    if(d?.id)dids.add(d.id);
    if(typeof d?.name!=='string'||!d.name.trim())issues.push(`掉落規則 ${d?.id||i+1} 顯示名稱不可空白。`);
    if(typeof d?.enabled!=='boolean')issues.push(`掉落規則 ${d?.id||i+1} enabled 必須是布林值。`);
    if(!dropTypes.has(d?.type))issues.push(`掉落規則 ${d?.id||i+1} 掉落類型無效。`);
    if(!Array.isArray(d?.kinds)||!d.kinds.length||d.kinds.some(k=>!dropKinds.has(k)))issues.push(`掉落規則 ${d?.id||i+1} 遭遇種類無效。`);
    if(!Number.isInteger(d?.quantityMin)||!Number.isInteger(d?.quantityMax)||d.quantityMin<1||d.quantityMax<d.quantityMin||d.quantityMax>999)issues.push(`掉落規則 ${d?.id||i+1} 數量必須是 1~999 整數，且最大值不可小於最小值。`);
    if(d?.type==='material'&&(typeof d.key!=='string'||!d.key.trim()))issues.push(`掉落規則 ${d?.id||i+1} 的指定材料名稱不可空白。`);
    if(d?.type==='gem'&&d.key!=='random'&&![0,1,2,'0','1','2'].includes(d.key))issues.push(`掉落規則 ${d?.id||i+1} 的寶石 key 只能是 random、0、1、2。`);
    if(d?.type==='item'&&!data.items.some(x=>x.id===d.key))issues.push(`掉落規則 ${d?.id||i+1} 指定的商店道具不存在。`);
    if(Array.isArray(d?.sources)&&Array.isArray(d?.kinds)){const kinds=new Set(d.kinds);for(const id of d.sources){const m=monsterById.get(id);if(!m)continue;const compatible=m.kind==='normal'?['normal','elite']:[m.kind];if(!compatible.some(k=>kinds.has(k)))issues.push(`掉落規則 ${d.id||i+1} 的來源「${m.name||id}」與遭遇種類不相容。`);}}
  }
  return [...new Set(issues)];
};
</script>

    if(d?.type==='material'&&(typeof d.key!=='string'||!d.key.trim()))issues.push(`掉落規則 ${d?.id||i+1} 的指定材料名稱不可空白。`);

    if(Array.isArray(d?.sources)&&Array.isArray(d?.kinds)){const kinds=new Set(d.kinds);for(const id of d.sources){const m=monsterById.get(id);if(!m)continue;const compatible=m.kind==='normal'?['normal','elite']:[m.kind];if(!compatible.some(k=>kinds.has(k)))issues.push(`掉落規則 ${d.id||i+1} 的來源「${m.name||id}」與遭遇種類不相容。`);}}
  }
  return [...new Set(issues)];
};

function normalizeEditorUIText(input){
  const src=input&&typeof input==='object'&&!Array.isArray(input)?input:{};const out={};
  for(const [key,def] of Object.entries(UI_TEXT_DEFAULTS))out[key]=typeof src[key]==='string'?src[key]:def;
  return out;
}

<script id="manual-boss-challenge-editor">
/* Update 26 editor: normal-map bosses use banked manual challenge stages instead of random encounters. */
(function installManualBossChallengeEditor(){
  const bossDefaults={normalProgress:1,eliteMultiplier:1.5,progressPerCharge:100,maxCharges:100,maxStageEnemies:20};
  BALANCE_SETTINGS_DEFAULTS.monsters.bossMeter ??=structuredClone(bossDefaults);

  function normalizeBossStageEditorRow(m){
    if(!m||typeof m!=='object')return m;
    if(!Number.isInteger(m.bossStageCount)||m.bossStageCount<0)m.bossStageCount=m.kind==='normal'?0:1;
    m.bossStageCount=Math.max(0,Math.min(20,m.bossStageCount));
    if(!Number.isInteger(m.bossStageOrder)||m.bossStageOrder<0)m.bossStageOrder=m.kind==='normal'?10:100;
    m.bossStageOrder=Math.max(0,Math.min(999,m.bossStageOrder));
    m.bossStageElite=m.kind==='normal'&&m.bossStageElite===true;
    return m;
  }
  BALANCE_SETTINGS_DEFAULTS.monsters.catalog=(BALANCE_SETTINGS_DEFAULTS.monsters.catalog||[]).map(m=>normalizeBossStageEditorRow(m));
  for(const m of BALANCE_SETTINGS_DEFAULTS.maps?.catalog||[])if(m?.mapType!=='final')m.bossChance=0;
  BALANCE_SETTINGS_DEFAULTS.monsters.encounter.bossChance=0;

  const bossEditorEnsureBase=ensureArrays;
  ensureArrays=function(){
    bossEditorEnsureBase();
    data.balanceSettings.monsters.encounter.bossChance=0;
    data.balanceSettings.monsters.bossMeter={...structuredClone(bossDefaults),...(data.balanceSettings.monsters.bossMeter||{})};
    data.balanceSettings.monsters.catalog=(data.balanceSettings.monsters.catalog||[]).map(m=>normalizeBossStageEditorRow(m));
    for(const m of data.balanceSettings.maps?.catalog||[])if(m?.mapType!=='final')m.bossChance=0;
  };

  function bossStageTotal(mi){
    const rows=data.balanceSettings.monsters.catalog.filter(m=>m.mapIndex===mi),map=data.balanceSettings.maps.catalog[mi];if(!map||map.mapType==='final')return 0;
    return 1+rows.filter(m=>m.kind==='normal').reduce((n,m)=>n+(Number(m.bossStageCount)||0),0);
  }
  function bossMeterSettingsHtml(){
    const b=data.balanceSettings.monsters.bossMeter;

      <label>普通怪進度（%）<input class="boss-meter-field" data-key="normalProgress" type="number" min="0.001" step="0.1" value="${esc(b.normalProgress)}"></label>
      <label>菁英進度倍率<input class="boss-meter-field" data-key="eliteMultiplier" type="number" min="0.001" step="0.1" value="${esc(b.eliteMultiplier)}"></label>
      <label>每次挑戰需要進度（%）<input class="boss-meter-field" data-key="progressPerCharge" type="number" min="1" step="1" value="${esc(b.progressPerCharge)}"></label>
      <label>挑戰次數累積上限<input class="boss-meter-field" data-key="maxCharges" type="number" min="1" max="1000" step="1" value="${esc(b.maxCharges)}"></label>
      <label>BOSS 關卡敵人上限<input class="boss-meter-field" data-key="maxStageEnemies" type="number" min="1" max="100" step="1" value="${esc(b.maxStageEnemies)}"></label>
    </div></div></section>`;
  }

<script id="turn-duration-editor-system">
(function installTurnDurationEditorSystem(){
  const TIME_UNITS={supportDuration:'battleRounds',itemDuration:'battleRounds'};
  function roundReferenceMs(obj){return Math.max(1,Number(obj?.balanceSettings?.combat?.pacing?.roundMinimumMs)||6000);}
  function normalizeTurnUnitsInPlace(obj){
    if(!obj||typeof obj!=='object')return obj;
    const legacyItems=obj?.timeUnits?.itemDuration!=='battleRounds',refSec=roundReferenceMs(obj)/1000;
    if(Array.isArray(obj.items)&&legacyItems)for(const item of obj.items)if(Number.isFinite(item.duration))item.duration=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Math.max(0,item.duration)/refSec));
    obj.timeUnits={...(obj.timeUnits||{}),...TIME_UNITS};
    if(obj._reference?.units){obj._reference.units.duration='BUFF／DEBUFF 為戰鬥回合；消耗品為角色出戰回合';obj._reference.units.cooldown='技能冷卻為施放者自身行動回合';}
    obj.notes=[...new Set([...(obj.notes||[]).filter(x=>!String(x).includes('BUFF／DEBUFF 與消耗品持續時間統一為回合制')),'supportSkills[].duration 單位為戰鬥回合；其數值原本實際就是依 partyClock 回合推進，因此舊數值直接保留。','items[].duration 單位為角色出戰的戰鬥回合；舊版現實秒會依 1× 每回合最短時間換算為回合後匯入。'])];
    return obj;
  }
  globalThis.normalizeTurnUnitsInPlace=normalizeTurnUnitsInPlace;
  normalizeTurnUnitsInPlace(data);
  const turnEnsureArraysBase=ensureArrays;
  ensureArrays=function(){const out=turnEnsureArraysBase();if(data?.timeUnits?.itemDuration!=='battleRounds'||data?.timeUnits?.supportDuration!=='battleRounds')normalizeTurnUnitsInPlace(data);return out;};
  const turnValidateBase=validateData;
  validateData=function(){const issues=turnValidateBase();ensureArrays();for(const [ci,list] of (data.supportSkills||[]).entries())for(const [si,sk] of (list||[]).entries()){if(!Number.isInteger(sk.duration)||sk.duration<0)issues.push(`角色 ${ci} 輔助技能 ${si} 的持續回合必須是非負整數。`);if(!Number.isInteger(sk.cooldown)||sk.cooldown<0)issues.push(`角色 ${ci} 輔助技能 ${si} 的冷卻自身回合必須是非負整數。`);}for(const item of data.items||[])if(!Number.isInteger(item.duration)||item.duration<0)issues.push(`道具 ${item.id} 的持續出戰回合必須是非負整數。`);return [...new Set(issues)];};
  const turnRenderBase=render;
  render=function(){turnRenderBase();if(currentSection==='support'){const head=document.querySelector('.section-head p');if(head)head.textContent='輔助技能持續時間以戰鬥回合計算；冷卻以施放者自身行動回合計算。';}if(currentSection==='items'){const head=document.querySelector('.section-head p');if(head)head.textContent='消耗品效果持續時間以角色出戰的戰鬥回合計算；暫停、候補與關閉頁面不會扣減。';}};
  /* Rebind raw/import paths indirectly through ensureArrays; normalize the currently loaded data now. */
  markDirty('已將 BUFF／DEBUFF 與消耗品持續時間統一為回合制；尚未匯出');
  requestEditorInitialRender();
})();
</script>

(function installHealingPotionEditor(){

    {id:'heal_standard',type:HEAL_TYPE,cost:15,sellPrice:4,duration:0,cooldown:3,healFraction:.45,name:'治療藥水',description:'標準遠征治療藥水，在恢復量與成本之間取得平衡。'},
    {id:'heal_greater',type:HEAL_TYPE,cost:28,sellPrice:7,duration:0,cooldown:4,healFraction:.70,name:'強效治療藥水',description:'一次恢復較多生命，適合高壓戰鬥，但價格與冷卻較高。'},
    {id:'heal_supreme',type:HEAL_TYPE,cost:50,sellPrice:12,duration:0,cooldown:5,healFraction:1.00,name:'特級治療藥水',description:'可將生命大幅拉回安全線，主要用於危急狀況。'}
  ];

/* Update 32 editor: random shop rules + fixed-item shop availability/descriptions. */
(function installShopSettingsEditor(){
  const clone=v=>structuredClone(v);
  const DEFAULT_SHOP_SETTINGS={randomOffers:{offerCount:6,refreshBaseCost:100,refreshCostStep:50,entries:[
    {id:'ore',enabled:true,type:'ore',key:'',name:'鍛鐵',description:'裝備強化常用素材。',quantityMin:8,quantityMax:20,unitPrice:12,weight:1,quantityScalesWithTier:true,priceScalesWithTier:false},
    {id:'dust',enabled:true,type:'dust',key:'',name:'粉塵',description:'裝備洗鍊與寶石相關用途的基礎素材。',quantityMin:3,quantityMax:8,unitPrice:25,weight:1,quantityScalesWithTier:false,priceScalesWithTier:false},
    {id:'gem',enabled:true,type:'gem',key:'random',name:'隨機技能寶石',description:'隨機出現一種技能寶石。',quantityMin:1,quantityMax:2,unitPrice:180,weight:.7,quantityScalesWithTier:false,priceScalesWithTier:false},
    {id:'region_material',enabled:true,type:'material',key:'region',name:'地區素材',description:'從目前探索區域的怪物素材中隨機挑選。',quantityMin:3,quantityMax:6,unitPrice:60,weight:1.3,quantityScalesWithTier:false,priceScalesWithTier:true}
  ]}};
  const TYPES=['ore','dust','gem','material'],TYPE_LABEL={ore:'鍛鐵',dust:'粉塵',gem:'技能寶石',material:'素材'};
  function normalizeRule(x,i){const type=TYPES.includes(x?.type)?x.type:'material';return {id:typeof x?.id==='string'&&x.id.trim()?x.id.trim():'rule_'+i,enabled:x?.enabled!==false,type,key:typeof x?.key==='string'?x.key:(type==='gem'?'random':type==='material'?'region':''),name:typeof x?.name==='string'?x.name:'',description:typeof x?.description==='string'?x.description:'',quantityMin:Number.isFinite(x?.quantityMin)?Math.max(1,Math.floor(x.quantityMin)):1,quantityMax:Number.isFinite(x?.quantityMax)?Math.max(1,Math.floor(x.quantityMax)):1,unitPrice:Number.isFinite(x?.unitPrice)?Math.max(0,Math.round(x.unitPrice)):1,weight:Number.isFinite(x?.weight)&&x.weight>0?x.weight:1,quantityScalesWithTier:!!x?.quantityScalesWithTier,priceScalesWithTier:!!x?.priceScalesWithTier};}
  function ensureShopSettings(){
    const raw=data.shopSettings?.randomOffers||{},def=DEFAULT_SHOP_SETTINGS.randomOffers,entries=Array.isArray(raw.entries)&&raw.entries.length?raw.entries:def.entries;
    data.shopSettings={randomOffers:{offerCount:Number.isFinite(raw.offerCount)?Math.max(1,Math.min(24,Math.floor(raw.offerCount))):def.offerCount,refreshBaseCost:Number.isFinite(raw.refreshBaseCost)?Math.max(0,Math.round(raw.refreshBaseCost)):def.refreshBaseCost,refreshCostStep:Number.isFinite(raw.refreshCostStep)?Math.max(0,Math.round(raw.refreshCostStep)):def.refreshCostStep,entries:entries.map(normalizeRule)}};
    for(const r of data.shopSettings.randomOffers.entries)if(r.quantityMax<r.quantityMin)r.quantityMax=r.quantityMin;
    for(const item of data.items||[])if(typeof item.shopEnabled!=='boolean')item.shopEnabled=true;
    selected.shopRule??=0;
  }
  const baseEnsure=ensureArrays;ensureArrays=function(){const out=baseEnsure();ensureShopSettings();return out;};ensureShopSettings();
  if(!SECTION_META.some(x=>x[0]==='shopSettings')){const i=SECTION_META.findIndex(x=>x[0]==='items');SECTION_META.splice(i<0?SECTION_META.length:i,0,['shopSettings','商店設定']);}
